The Pivot Lab

No model, no score, no threshold — just the daily episode tracker's own pivots. Slide k and watch which turns it keeps: this is the same mechanism that decides what a "reversal" even is, before anything scores it.

drag to pan · wheel/pinch to zoom · double-click resets · ▽ peak pivot (origin of a down-reversal) · △ trough pivot (origin of an up-reversal) · shaded band = one episode, anchor to end, at the current k
